declaration.reason: Add the owner-facing, read-only signature recovery assessment screen for IRPA-ENV-2026-11501354. Scope is limited to authenticated owner-scoped queue/evidence retrieval and a watermarked non-authoritative preview; it performs no recovery action.

files.expectedEffect: Declares this single-portal repair scope, prohibitions, baseline and evidence; governance record only.
References the already-open owner-approved 72-hour Signature Portal repair window; no signing behaviour change.
Documents proposed owner self-service generalisation; documentation only, not implemented runtime behaviour.
Mounts the recovery assessment panel in the non-signer owner-facing Signature Portal view.
Provides authenticated owner-scoped read-only recovery queue/evidence access and a watermarked preview; no recovery mutation controls.

declaration.expectedEffect: Owners can inspect protected recovery evidence and a watermarked preview without changing the affected envelope or its original signature evidence.
prohibitedChanges: Do not change, reassign, delete or recreate any existing signature or signer evidence.
Do not automatically retry signing or finalisation.
Do not complete or otherwise change any envelope status.
Do not write to any envelope, signer, field, token, hash, certificate or archive record.
Do not change signing rules, token or link formats, sessions, signer identity, field assignment, stamping, PDF generation, hash, certificate or archive logic.
Do not change Firestore rules, secrets, environment variables, SMTP settings or branch protection.
Do not change another portal or weaken authentication, signing, invitation, deletion or deployment controls.
lockTests: Dedicated recovery-screen tests asserting GET-only requests, owner 403/signed-out 401, sanitisation, malformed-response error boundary and absence of mutation controls are NOT PRESENT/NOT VERIFIED; prohibited behaviour is therefore declared but not yet test-enforced.
